cases.title: A 2 m pipe gets its label on a leader: CE asks to snap the callout arrow to the pipe, places exactly one multileader, and draws no plain label along the pipe

cases.expected: CD from 150000,-80000 to 152000,-80000 with inverts 18.000 / 17.990 and Start Pipe: CE asks 'Snap callout arrow to pipe:'; a click on the pipe at 151000,-80000 and a click for the text at 151000,-78500 place the label; the CD run then offers the next pipe and Esc ends it. The drawing gains exactly one pipe, exactly one multileader, and no plain text containing ' DIA. '; 'Pipe text callout cancelled.' is never printed.

not_automated: The leader's arrow point lying on the pipe (card assertion 2) and the leader's look are a Codex look; the arrow point is not readable by the robot.
